svg.text: Nested cross-validation for hyperparameter optimisation of the DPN classifier
Repeated stratified outer loop · Optuna TPE inner loop · leakage-free decision-threshold selection
187 patients × 22 predictors: Sudoscan foot / hand mean ESC and % asymmetry, MNSI, NS, CAS,
plus clinical and demographic variables (sex, age, DM duration, HbA1c, insulin, HPN, PAOD, CKD, ...). NCS-derived columns excluded.
Class balance — preserved by stratification in every split
k = 4 folds × 10 repeats = 40 outer iterations · random_state = 42
Touched once only, after tuning and
One repeat = 4 outer iterations, each block ≈ 46–47 patients
Within one repeat the four test folds tile the whole cohort: every patient is tested exactly once.
Inner loop — hyperparameter search, repeated inside every outer iteration
StratifiedKFold k = 3 on the outer-training set only. The splits are materialised once and reused by every trial.
Outer-training set of one outer iteration n = 140–141
Optuna TPE sampler — 100 trials per outer iteration
Objective: maximise the mean AUPRC (average precision)
• early_stopping_rounds = 50, monitored on the inner validation fold
• The winning trial carries both tuned and fixed parameters forward
300 model fits per outer iteration — 100 trials × 3 inner folds.
The threshold is chosen on out-of-fold predictions of the outer-training set — never on the outer test fold.
Best parameters refit on the full
3 further refits over the same inner
the F-score with β = 1 is retained.
The refit model and its threshold are applied once to the untouched outer test fold (n = 46–47; DPN+ 32–33 · DPN− 14–15).
specificity, F1, F1.25, F1.5, F1.75, F2, Youden J
Threshold-free: ROC-AUC, AUPRC · plus the threshold itself
NaN-aware: degenerate folds dropped per metric
First repeat (iterations 1–4) persisted with its models
Sampled by Optuna TPE inside every outer iteration
scale_pos_weight below 1 down-weights the majority DPN-positive class.
Identical in every trial, fold and repeat
CV seeds: 42 for the outer loop, 42 + outer-iteration index for the inner loop.
AUPRC — average precision, meaned over the 3 inner folds
F-score with β = 1 (F1), maximised on the inner OOF PR curve
Reporting only — no fitting or selection happens here
40 outer iterations × (100 trials × 3 inner fits + 1 refit + 3 OOF refits)
Coverage check: within each repeat the four test folds tile the
entire cohort (187 unique indices), asserted at runtime.
Models, splits and metrics of the first repeat are saved for reuse.

Implementation: nested_cv_optimization(), module/utils2/optimization.py · configuration: module/experiments/bin_opt_final_202608.yml · scikit-learn RepeatedStratifiedKFold / StratifiedKFold, Optuna TPESampler, CatBoost.
